title: No-boundary proposal (before the Big Bang)
example_questions: What happened before the Big Bang?
summary: Hartle and Hawking proposed that near the Big Bang, time behaves like a direction of space, so the universe has no initial edge, like the South Pole has nothing south of it. Asking what came before the Big Bang would then be meaningless.
support_note: Influential but debated; its mathematical definition remains contested.
what_happens: Shrinking back toward the start, time becomes space-like
The geometry closes off smoothly like a rounded cap
There is no moment before the beginning
objections: Recent analyses question whether the proposal gives a well behaved universe

sources.title: Wave function of the Universe
sources.authors: J. B. Hartle, S. W. Hawking
